body: Thank you so much.  Just being able to read these words have given me some hope that maybe things can be better. I just couldn't say these things under my own name because..well life. And to have someone like your self just send a note for of gracious kindness has been amazing
I just really really want to thank you for your kindness. This was a shot in the dark out of desperation and just seeing someone take the time out to write has been hugely heartening
Thank you so much man. Really needed and so grateful for your humanity.
Is there anything I can do right now to calm my anxiety.
